Name: Dwarf and Krobus Narrative Overhauls - The Monster Pack
Author: haywrites
Description:
[size=4][i][color=#6fa8dc][size=5]Welcome to the Monster Pack![/size][/color]
[/i][/size]
[size=4]In these [color=#cc4125]Dwarf[/color] and [color=#d8d8d8]Krobus[/color] Narrative Overhauls, I’ve added new sayings for every heart level for every weekday of every season.

However, in this Narrative Overhaul, you must work to become friends with [color=#cc4125]Dwarf[/color] and [color=#999999]Krobus[/color]!

[color=#cc4125]Dwarf[/color] puts you through the Trial Of Rejection until the 6th heart level, and [color=#b6b6b6]Krobus[/color] doesn’t know how to speak your language until the 6th heart level.
[color=#fff2cc]
ENDGAME FRIENDSHIP MAKING![/color]
Overall, that’s [color=#e06666]315+[/color] lines of dialogue (excluding [color=#cccccc]Krobus[/color] Friday Silences in that count.)

[font=Verdana][size=4]1.3 And Beyond
With 1.3, the way .xnb files are found has been changed! In order to use my mods, you must
use the versatile and friendly Content Patcher.

How to install Content Patcher and the Mods:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Download Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[*]Unzip the contents of Content Patcher into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Install any content packs (Narrative Overhauls) you want by unzipping them into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
A bit more complicated versus what it was before, but at least it will be possible!
For the Content Patcher version of this mod, download the 1.3 Multiplayer Patch Version of this mod!

(The latest versions of the mod files, uploaded 6/6/18, are the official versions, with the most up to date patches.)

PRE 1.3:
(THE BELOW WILL NOT WORK IF YOU HAVE THE MOST UP TO DATE VERSION OF STARDEW
VALLEY. See the "1.3 and Beyond" section above if you have the most
recent patch (1.3 Multiplayer)[/size][/font][/size]
[size=4]
How to install:
Incredibly simple:
1. Download and Unzip the XNB file.
2. Go to where you installed Stardew Valley.
3. Go to Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Dialogue
4. Move the XNB file over and overwrite the old one.
5. You're done!
This mod is Rated E, and uses no gender pronouns for your player character.

[color=#ead1dc][size=4][b]Perfect 10 Edition NOW AVAILABLE![/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ead1dc][color=#ff0000]❤[/color]For people who get Dwarf's and Krobus' Heart Level to 10![color=#ff0000]❤
[/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=3]A re-edited version of the Narrative Overhaul, this adds dialogue for every day of every season. What's special about this Perfect 10 Edition is I wrote 52 new lines of dialogue for Dwarf and Krobus!

I suggest this mod only for people who got their heart levels to 10 and want to see unique dialogue for every day of the year.
The installation is the same, just overwrite the old .xnb file![/size][/color][/color]
[/size]
